functionality: typosquatting, where malicious actors create packages with names strikingly similar to legitimate ones to deceive developers
operational_techniques: use of Discord, Repl.it, glitch, GitHub, and Heroku as command-and-control servers
promotion of hacking tools with hidden backdoors

leaked Disney+ and Minecraft accounts on underground hacker forums
mitigation_measures: monitoring of dependencies for typosquatting attacks
